title: I’m a father of three who studies the impact of artificial intelligence: this is what parents need to know about AI
snippet: A Dr Seuss-style story written in seconds alerted me to the power – and perils – of the technology. But how can children embrace it without forgetting core skills? When I was growing up, my dad and I often talked about a story we wanted to write together. It was called “The Day Nobody Went to Disneyland”. One day, the story goes, the weather is so perfect that everyone in the world decides to stay away from Disneyland because they expect it to be far too busy. But my dad, who has the same thought as them, sees the disappointment on my face that morning – and decides to risk it. We set off. And when we arrive, the park is completely empty. Nobody else was brave enough to visit. We have everything – the rides, shows, food – to ourselves. I loved the idea of writing that story. Washington’s push to end the fighting has lost momentum as U.S. attention has been focused for the past six months on the Iran war. title: [COVER STORY] Japan's shareholder activism boom: Benchmark for Korea, or cautionary tale?
snippet: Korea and Japan have long shared a corporate governance problem: companies in which insiders, such as founding families, wield outsized influence often at the expense of minority shareholders. Both governments have sought to shift that balance by strengthening shareholder rights and pressing companies to improve governance and capital efficiency. Japan moved first, introducing a stewardship code in 2014 and a corporate governance code the following year. The Tokyo Stock Exchange's 2023 directive urging management to be "conscious of cost of capital and stock price" gave activists a clearer framework for engagement. That supportive policy environment has helped turn Japan into one of the biggest markets for shareholder activism. The accompanying focus on capital efficiency has also helped underpin the rise in Japanese equities. snippet: When a U.S. fund began challenging SK Telecom in 1999, corporate Korea was only beginning to learn what shareholder activism looked like. Tiger Management built a 6.6 percent stake in the country's largest wireless carrier and pressed for changes, including stronger external oversight and a greater say in how the company was run. The Chey family, one of Korea's chaebol dynasties and the controlling family behind SK Group, spent about 2 trillion won defending its grip on the group. Within months, Tiger had reaped about 630 billion won ($463.6 million) from selling its stake. title: US diesel prices hit record $5.85 a gallon
snippet: US diesel prices hit record $5.85 a gallon The price of diesel hit a new record Friday in the United States, as disruption from the US war with Iran squeezes voters. The cost is now $5.85 a gallon, up from $3.71 a year ago, the AAA motorists' association said. Diesel is used by farmers to run equipment, and it also powers the trucks needed to bring food to grocery stores. US farmers faced a double whammy of surging fertiliser and diesel prices as the spring planting season got underway. The Independent Grocers Alliance estimates that fuel-related costs can account for 15 to 30 percent of the total cost for some food products. Besides diesel, the cost of regular gasoline is also notably higher at an average of $4.15 per gallon, compared with $3.20 last year. (Reporting by AFP)

title: Industry minister urges US to ease tariffs on hard-to-source steel mill equipment
snippet: Korea's industry minister urged the United States on Saturday to ease tariffs on equipment that Korean companies will need to import for a $5.8 billion steel mill in Louisiana they are investing in. Industry Minister Kim Jung-kwan made the request at a meeting with Louisiana Gov. Jeff Landry before attending a groundbreaking ceremony for Hyundai-POSCO Louisiana Steel LLC (HPLS), an electric arc furnace-based integrated steel mill scheduled to begin construction in the fourth quarter, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources said in a press release. title: Kpler says Hormuz traffic dropped sharply on 31 August, Bab el-Mandeb stable
snippet: Kpler says Hormuz traffic dropped sharply on 31 August, Bab el-Mandeb stable Traffic through the Strait of Hormuz fell sharply on August 31, with five confirmed crossings, down 50 percent from 10 a day earlier, according to maritime data firm Kpler. Four vessels entered the Middle East Gulf and one exited, using a mix of Iranian, Omani and negotiated routes. Two of the crossings involved shadow vessels, while one involved a sanctioned vessel. Kpler said the figure remained preliminary, noting that additional “dark” crossings could be retrospectively identified and added as new confirmation data becomes available. Activity through the Bab el-Mandeb was comparatively stable, with 35 confirmed crossings, up 2.9 percent day on day. Nineteen vessels entered the Red Sea and 16 exited. No dark transits were recorded, while the International Maritime Organization verified no additional attacks. The sale will also “support the foreign policy goals and national security objectives of the United States by improving the security of a Major non-NATO Ally,” the department said.

title: Central Romania: Restored castle in Covasna reopens to the public
snippet: The Miko Castle in the village of Olteni, Covasna County, which has been restored with EU funding, is set to reopen its doors on Saturday, September 5, Agerpres reported. Built in 1827 by Count Miko Miklos, the castle is notable for the murals discovered on its interior walls during the restoration work. The paintings depict scenes from the social life of the period, as well as scenes from the Napoleonic Wars. The property was returned to the descendants of Count Miko in 2007. Seven years later, they sold it to the Covasna County Council and the Bodoc Local Council. The restoration was carried out as part of a project worth approximately RON 20 million, co-financed by EU funds through the National Recovery and Resilience Plan (PNRR). The castle will house the Székely Equestrian Museum, a section of the Székely National Museum in Sfântu Gheorghe. title: Japan's defense minister to skip annual security dialogue in Seoul after war shrine visit: sources
snippet: Japanese Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi is expected to skip an annual security forum in Seoul early next week, sources familiar with the matter said Friday, a move seen as related to his recent visit to a controversial war shrine in Tokyo that drew criticism from Seoul. Koizumi will not attend the Seoul Defense Dialogue (SDD), set for Monday through Wednesday, multiple sources told Yonhap News Agency. A vice defense minister from Tokyo will be present in his place, Seoul's defense ministry said. Koizumi had been widely expected to attend next week's forum, given the brisk high-level defense diplomacy between the two neighbors amid a warming of bilateral relations. His predecessor, Gen Kanatani, attended last year's SDD. While the exact reason for his absence remains unclear, Koizumi's visit to the Yasukuni Shrine last month may have affected the decision. Under the plan, National Land Satellite No. 3 will be launched in 2030, followed by No. 4 in 2031. The government currently operates National Land Satellite No. 1, while No. 2, launched in May, is undergoing test operations and is scheduled to begin public services later this year. Satellite No. 1 began official operations in December 2021 and has been used to monitor changes in land use, manage infrastructure and mountainous areas, respond to natural disasters and produce geospatial information and maps. title: 忧劳工荒与粮食安全 移民政策触发业界警告
snippet: 【大纪元2026年09月04日讯】（大纪元记者夏楚君澳洲悉尼编译报导）联邦政府正因其移民政策改革面临来自各行业团体的强烈反对。业界担忧，若缺乏足够的外籍劳工，非大都市地区的住宿餐饮业将面临倒闭风险，粮食安全也可能受到威胁。 联邦政府正努力将净海外移民人数从30万降至22.5万的目标。上个月，政府已悄悄暂停了来自24个国家的打工度假签证申请。 9月2日，二十多个行业协会就这些变化致信总理阿尔巴尼斯，警告这些举措可能损害相关产业，并威胁到澳洲与亚洲国家达成的“肥料换粮食”协议。数据显示，背包客占园艺采收高峰期劳动力的44%。 “我们共同呼吁政府立即明确其对打工度假签证改革的意图，阐明当前行政措施的范围和影响，并承诺进行磋商”，行业领袖们表示。 据悉尼晨锋报网站报导，包括全澳农民联合会（National Farmers Federation）、澳洲小企业理事会（COSBOA）以及澳洲餐饮协会（ARCA）在内的团体表示，背包客扮演着双重角色：作为游客，他们在非大都市地区停留的时间比一般游客更长；作为劳工，餐厅、咖啡馆、酒店、酒馆、零售及托儿服务等行业均对其高度依赖。他们强调：“这些服务正是支撑这些社区宜居性的关键。” 澳洲酒店协会（AHA）会长史蒂芬·弗格森（Stephen Ferguson）批评政府未能重视本地餐饮培训，导致酒馆和俱乐部不得不高度依赖背包客和国际学生。他表示，目前引进一名外劳从申请获准到入境需耗时九个月至一年。 然而，并非所有人都同意企业界的诉求。前生产力委员会经济学家卡达·莱斯利（Cathal Leslie）在《澳洲金融评论报》撰文反驳了行业的担忧。他认为，澳洲可以降低攻读医学学位所需的ATAR分数，提高老年护理人员的工资以吸引本地人，并停止使用廉价劳动力，转而进行创新。 背包客问题目前已成为澳洲移民辩论中颇具争议的一环。国家党（Nationals）及一国党（One Nation）均承诺保护前往偏远地区的背包客渠道，认为他们对农业和地方经济至关重要。 另一方面，朝野对于减少国际学生人数则存在较广泛共识。政府已将签证费大幅提高至远高于其它国家的2500澳元，并在最近一段时间内拒签了创纪录的40%的申请。 责任编辑：宗敏青 了解更多澳洲即时要闻及生活资讯，请点击 dajiyuan.com.au （本文未经许可不得转载或建立镜像网站）

title: Council of Europe report: Romania makes progress against detainee ill-treatment, but overcrowding persists
snippet: Romania has made significant progress in preventing the ill-treatment of people held by the police and in prisons, according to a new report by the Council of Europe’s Committee for the Prevention of Torture (CPT). However, the committee warned that conditions in police detention facilities remain very poor and that prisons are operating at 119.5% capacity. The report presented the findings of a 2025 visit to five police detention facilities, four prisons in Botoșani, Bucharest-Rahova, Craiova, and Iași, and two detention centres for children and young adults in Craiova and Târgu Ocna. The CPT welcomed the authorities’ “zero-tolerance policy towards ill-treatment” and noted an improvement in police conduct. title: UN chief urges US, Iran to 'return urgently to diplomacy' after renewed attacks
snippet: UN chief urges US, Iran to 'return urgently to diplomacy' after renewed attacks UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres on Wednesday expressed "grave concern" after renewed strikes between the US and Iran, and condemned all attacks against civilians. "The secretary-general is deeply alarmed by reports of civilian casualties, including a strike that reportedly hit a wedding ceremony in Iran," UN spokesperson Stephane Dujarric said during a news conference. "The secretary-general condemns all attacks against civilians," Dujarric said. "He recalls that all parties must respect their obligations under international humanitarian law, including the principles of distinction, proportionality, and precaution." He added that the UN chief urged Washington and Tehran to "return urgently to diplomacy," adding that a "comprehensive and durable settlement can be achieved only through dialog and negotiations".

title: Samsung Electronics to launch Galaxy S26 FE on Friday
snippet: Samsung Electronics Co. said Thursday it will launch the Galaxy S26 FE in Korea later this week. The latest budget Galaxy model will go on sale Friday, the tech giant said. The Galaxy S26 FE features the latest camera capabilities and artificial intelligence (AI), offering a user experience comparable to that of Samsung's flagship smartphones. The device runs Galaxy AI based on One UI 9, the company's latest operating system. It supports features such as Now Brief, which understands users' context and provides personalized information, and Now Nudge, which proactively suggests actions based on users' needs. The phone features My PanCam, which tracks the movements of specific people in videos, and Super Steady with a horizon lock option to help users capture more stable footage. The Galaxy S26 FE will be available with 256 gigabytes of storage in three colors — Blueberry, Graphite and Pistachio. It is priced at 1.05 million won ($772).

title: 2 Korean officials named World Customs Organization-certified experts
snippet: Two Korean officials were selected as World Customs Organization (WCO) Accredited Experts, the Korea Customs Service (KCS) said Wednesday. The two officials are Kim Kye-yeong, an IT official, and Kim Kwan-woo, a customs official at Gimhae Airport Customs. They were accredited as technical and operational advisors in the fields of single window and data analytics, respectively, on Aug. 25. The number of KCS officials currently serving as WCO Accredited Experts has risen to nine. WCO Accredited Experts are customs officials from member countries who have been officially certified by the WCO for their professional expertise and practical capabilities. They join the WCO's pool of experts supporting capacity building in customs administration and participate in a range of training, technical assistance and advisory activities. title: Hanwha Ocean clinches $1.14 bil. deal for 6 container ships from Taiwan's Yang Ming
snippet: Hanwha Ocean Co. said Thursday it has won a 1.55 trillion-won ($1.14 billion) order from Taiwan's Yang Ming Marine Transport Corp. to build six liquefied natural gas (LNG) dual-fuel container ships. The Korean shipbuilder said the 13,650 twenty-foot equivalent unit (TEU) vessels will be built at its shipyard in the southeastern city of Geoje and delivered by the second half of 2029. The vessels will be equipped with Hanwha Ocean's high-manganese steel-based Type-B LNG fuel tanks, designed to improve both safety and cost efficiency. The latest contract marks Yang Ming's second order from Hanwha Ocean, following a 1.93 trillion-won deal for seven 15,880-TEU LNG dual-fuel container ships in September 2025.

title: AI banned for elementary, middle school students in NYC
snippet: NEW YORK — New York City’s public schools will temporarily ban elementary and middle school students from using generative artificial intelligence tools during the upcoming school year, Mayor Zohran Mamdani announced Wednesday. The one-year moratorium — part of a broader assessment of how children in the nation’s largest school system interact with the technology — will apply to “all software that uses student-facing generative AI” for students through eighth grade, the mayor’s office said. It described the policy as the most expansive prohibition in the country. At the same time, the city will establish twice-yearly AI literacy classes for all public high school students. It will also launch pilot programs allowing some high school students to use a handful of AI platforms under an educator’s supervision. title: Da geração que mudou o sertanejo feminino: Emy e Thaeme lançam ‘Tudo Menos Eu'
snippet: Quando Emy e Thaeme iniciaram suas trajetórias profissionais, em meados de 2010, o sertanejo brasileiro vivia um cenário bem diferente. O gênero caminhava para uma de suas maiores expansões e a presença feminina, que anos depois se tornaria uma de suas grandes forças, ainda conquistava o seu espaço. Quase duas décadas depois, as duas artistas que acompanharam de dentro essa transformação, finalmente, se encontram musicalmente. Emy e Thaeme dividem os vocais de "Tudo Menos Eu", parceria inédita que chega às plataformas como parte do projeto "Lado EMY", iniciativa da cantora Emy, que promove encontros com grandes vozes femininas da música sertaneja. Thaeme tornou-se uma das vozes femininas mais conhecidas do grande público e construiu uma trajetória de destaque no gênero com sua dupla com Thiago, que permanece ativa e com grande sucesso nacional. Emy viveu mais de dez anos de sua carreira integrando o Trio Villa Baggage, ao lado de Guilherme e Benuto, grupo que ganhou projeção nacional.

snippet: Turkey replaces Russian oil and diesel imports from US as wars reverberate Turkey is turning to the United States for crude oil and refined products as supplies from Russia are jolted amid increasing Ukrainian attacks on its energy infrastructure, according to recent Turkish customs data. The US overtook Russia in June as Turkey’s main crude oil supplier with roughly 570,000 tonnes arriving compared to 425,000 from Russia. The numbers reflect how Ankara is reducing its exposure to Russian crude after emerging as one of its top buyers following Russia’s invasion of Ukraine. Turkey’s cut in Russian crude oil imports also comes as it purchases more diesel from the US and India. According to energy analytics firm Kpler, Turkey has imported more than 120,000 barrels per day of Indian diesel and 90,000 bpd of diesel from the US since August. title: FTC联同22州 控告亚马逊秘密提高广告附加费
snippet: 【大纪元2026年09月02日讯】（大纪元记者Kimberly Hayek报导／张纯之编译）美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）与22个州的总检察长周一（8月31日）对亚马逊（Amazon）提起诉讼，指控该公司多年来暗中操纵线上搜索广告竞价、秘密提高价格。 诉状指控，亚马逊隐瞒不公平收费长达七年多，导致上百万个品牌及卖家在该平台投放广告时支付更高的费用。官员表示，透过这种做法，该公司很可能从广告客户手中榨取了数百亿美元。 FTC主席安德鲁‧N‧弗格森（Andrew N. Ferguson）31日在声明中说，亚马逊拥有数以百万计的广告客户，他们被误导而支付明显更高的价格；而这些较高成本最终大部分都转嫁给了美国消费者。在川普总统领导下的FTC不会允许这种欺骗行为继续下去。 提告的州份包括阿拉斯加、亚利桑那、加州、科罗拉多、佛罗里达、爱达荷、伊利诺伊、印第安纳、爱荷华、肯塔基、路易斯安那、马里兰、内布拉斯加、新泽西、纽约、北卡罗来纳、俄克拉何马、宾夕法尼亚、罗德岛、南卡罗来纳、佛蒙特及华盛顿州。 广告商会透过竞价方式购买亚马逊赞助商品广告、赞助品牌广告及展示广告，这些广告会出现在Amazon.com搜索结果旁，以及亚马逊手机应用程序中。 诉状称，亚马逊多年来告诉广告商，其采用的是“第二高价”竞价机制，中标者只需比第二高出价多付“1美分”。假设竞标中最高出价10美元，第二高出价8美元，最终中标者只需支付8.01美元。 但诉状说，实际上，亚马逊近80%的时间直接收取中标者自己的出价（最高出价），使这些竞价变成了“第一高价”竞价。 诉状还称，亚马逊将这种竞价称为广义第二高价（GSP）竞价、也是业界标准，并在其网站、培训影片、公开资料及销售简报中作出说明。 在第一高价竞价中，竞标者可能面临出价过高的风险，因此通常会压低出价。在第二高价竞价中，竞标者往往更接近自己的真实估值出价，因为他们最终只需支付足以赢得竞标的价格。 根据诉状，自2019年起，亚马逊添加了一项未公开的附加费，公司内部称之为“软性保留价”（soft reserve price）。诉状援引一份内部文件称，这是一项“隐藏的附加费”，使得广告商支付的价格远高于真正的GSP竞价所需支付的金额。 诉状指出，亚马逊之所以作出这项改变，是因为对广告收入不满。亚马逊广告部门一名主管曾在内部解释，广告商实际支付的价格并不是由真正的竞标者决定
source: 大纪元 Epoch Times · 即时

snippet: ROWallet , Romania's first digital identity wallet, was officially announced by the Ministry of Internal Affairs on Tuesday, September 1. Romania’s digital wallet was adapted after RoEUDIW, the open-source solution developed by Germany, the government announced this June. title: Damaged drone reportedly found in field in eastern Romania
snippet: A damaged drone was found on Tuesday, September 1, in a field near Viișoara, Vaslui county, around 30 kilometers from Romania’s border with Moldova, according to News.ro . Authorities have isolated the area and launched an investigation into the aircraft’s origin and how it reached the site. A local resident reportedly discovered the drone outside the village and notified police. Preliminary information indicated that the aircraft might be carrying explosives, although this had not yet been confirmed. A Romanian Intelligence Service (SRI) bomb disposal team was sent to inspect and secure the drone. Police and gendarmerie personnel were also present at the site, according to media reports. “We are waiting for the results of the inspections,” Vaslui prefect Andrei Șerban told Agerpres . Police were notified about the discovery at 10:15 a.m. The Prosecutor’s Office attached to the Iași Court of Appeal was informed and will investigate the circumstances surrounding the incident. title: 美国拟取消H-4配偶工作许可 短期内无影响
snippet: 【大纪元2026年09月01日讯】（大纪元记者杨婕报导）美国国土安全部（DHS）已经把“取消部分H-4签证配偶工作许可”正式放入议事日程，不过短期内并不会予以关注，属于未来将要考虑的事项之一。 H-4签证是美国发给H-1B工作签证持有者的配偶或未婚、未满21岁子女的家属非移民签证。2015年，当时奥巴马总统当政时的DHS通过规则，允许某些持H-4签证的配偶获得工作许可（EAD）。今年DHS的这项议程将取消2015年的规则，恢复之前H-4配偶不能工作的政策。 这项待定议程并没有改变当前的H-4签证配偶工作许可规则，H-4工卡目前也没有被取消。 DHS日前把停止部分H-4工卡的提议列入了“统一监管议程”（Unified Regulatory Agenda）中，表示未来将要对其设定规则。但何时出炉拟议规则（NPRM），仍无具体日期。 亦即这项议事日程现在还处于非常早期阶段。Manifest移民律师事务所8月31日在其网站发文说，对持有工卡的H-4签证配偶及其雇主来说，目前没有任何变化。DHS需要先提出、并公布拟议规则，然后通过政府的审查，再接受公众评议。之后DHS要回复评议、公布最终规则。文章说，DHS现在把这个提议放在未来的行动项目里，等真正实施，“应该是几年以后而不是几个月的事”。 Ji Mobility Law也在8月29日的一篇帖文中说，该提议还尚未进入制定规则的正式程序，估计还有很长的一段路才能看到真正的政策变化。 这个政策变更会影响多少人？目前美国移民局没有公布更新的H-4配偶工卡统计。根据政策研究智库“美国国家政策基金会”（National Foundation for American Policy）在2022年底的一份报告，COVID疫情前的2019年，在美国的H-1B签证持有者大约是60万人，相关的H-4配偶估计是25万至45万人。 报告根据美国移民局数据估计，自2015年至2021年，有大约17万H-4签证配偶获得工卡。在2021年，H-4配偶工卡持有者大约是6万人。 报告根据2017—2019年的数据进行的统计，H-4签证的持有者90%以上是女性，其中67%来自印度，6%来自中国。他们中有半数的人在科学、技术、工程和数学（STEM）领域有研究生学历。报告说，这些H-4配偶是美国一支没有被充分利用的技术工作力量。 通过逆转奥巴马和拜登政府期间的移民政

title: Toy imports to Romania nearly double over five years
snippet: Romania’s toy imports reached more than EUR 900 million in 2025, nearly double their level five years earlier, according to data from Eurostat cited by Ziarul Financiar . The increase in import value significantly outpaced the growth in volumes, indicating a substantial rise in the average value of imported toys. Toy import volumes increased by about 40% between 2020 and 2025, while the value of imports almost doubled over the same period. The divergence reflects higher prices and a shift in the value of products entering the Romanian market. China was the largest source of toys imported by Romania, accounting for more than 22% of total imports. The country is a major global manufacturing centre for toys and supplies a substantial share of the European market. Greece was the second-largest source recorded in the European statistics, although part of these imports may consist of Chinese-made products entering Romania through Greek companies and distribution networks. O calendário do segundo semestre de 2026 ainda reserva seis feriados nacionais para os brasileiros. Além do 7 de setembro, outras quatro datas concederão folga nacional em segundas ou sextas-feiras, criando a possibilidade de finais de semana prolongados. Veja os próximos feriados nacionais: Feriados Nacionais Feriados Estaduais Fora do calendário nacional, estados e municípios também possuem feriados próprios, instituídos por leis locais e válidos apenas em seus respectivos territórios. Essas datas podem afetar o funcionamento de serviços públicos e privados e têm impacto sobre atividades como logística, comércio e atendimento. title: Sacramento should save the program that is saving the grid
snippet: Your power bill is too high. Electricity prices have risen by as much as 40% since 2020, far outpacing overall inflation. And after decades of nearly flat growth in energy consumption, data centers are driving up grid demand for the first time in roughly 35 years. Then heat waves, like the one currently cooking Southern California, push the whole system to the edge. That’s why In 2022, California launched the Demand Side Grid Support program. I ran the Department of Energy during the Biden administration. I know innovation when I see it. California’s grid program has been historic and should serve as a model for the entire United States. To understand the program, start with how the grid becomes strained. title: Romania cuts excise duty on diesel by 25% for two weeks
snippet: The Finance Ministry in Romania announced that it will cut the excise duty on diesel by 25% for the following two-week period, under the dynamic excise regime introduced for situations when diesel prices rise above certain benchmarks. The new excise duty rate applies for the period September 1-15, after a 20% cut in the excise duty was in force during the second half of August. Under the special regime, the excise duty is calculated every two weeks depending on international diesel quotations. The new adjustment represents a decrease of RON 701 per 1,000 litres. Thus, between September 1 and 15, 2026, the effective excise duty level for standard diesel on the domestic market will be RON 2,103 per 1,000 litres. “The mechanism provided for by Law no. 162/2026 operates gradually, depending on developments in the international market. title: 吉隆口岸被冲垮前 中共至少获三重危险警告
snippet: 【大纪元2026年08月31日讯】（大纪元记者呈工综合报导）发生在中尼边境的吉隆口岸的泥石流灾难，其发生之突然、受灾之惨烈、范围之广、伤亡之多，举世震惊。 迄今，中共当局至少获得过三重危险警告：12年前地质报告、计算机模拟，以及去年友谊桥被冲毁。资料显示，中共官方早已掌握吉隆地区存在严重地质灾害风险。 为何将吉隆口岸设在高风险地段？ 从相关视频可清楚地看到，吉隆口岸位于吉隆藏布与东林藏布两条河流的交汇处，地形陡峭，河谷非常狭窄，两边都是高山。 换言之，吉隆口岸的海关大楼、旅客检查区、货柜车场等，全部挤在河流下游中间一块有限的低洼地上，而周围却是数千米高的雪山。 在这种地形下，洪水和泥石流一旦从上游冲下来，口岸自然会成为最容易被集中冲击的地方。而吉隆口岸就是建造在这样的地形地貌之上。 据中共官媒报导，中共自然资源部专家分析称，今次灾害是由尼泊尔境内高山上的冰川崩塌引发。冰块、巨石和泥沙高速向下冲击，沿途再卷走沟道中的碎石和松散泥土，形成碎屑流，之后汇入东林藏布河，变成泥石流冲击吉隆口岸。 专家估计，泥石流的平均速度超过每秒50米，也就是时速约180公里。 2014年吉隆口岸评估出台 官方早知风险 2014年4月16日，中共官方《西藏日报》报导，西藏官员表示，要把吉隆口岸建成连通南亚贸易的“桥头堡”。官员说，加快建设吉隆口岸的条件已经具备，部分申报材料已经完成，其中包括《吉隆镇地质灾害评估报告》及《热索区域地质灾害评估报告》。 换言之，在大规模开发吉隆口岸之前，中共已经找人研究过：附近哪些地方可能发生山体崩塌，哪些地方可能出现泥石流，哪些位置建设建筑物特别危险。 中共官方报导称，当时已经完成了这些报告，为的是“加快口岸建设”。 问题是，这些报告到底画出了哪些危险区域？后来建成的口岸大楼、货车场和商业设施等，有没有建在报告指出的高风险范围内？ 关于相关报告，目前只能看到中共官方报导中所列出的报告名称，没有公开细节。因此，公众迄今无法知道，当时规划口岸时究竟采纳了哪些建议，又忽略了哪些警告。 其实，真正值得追问的不是“有没有做过报告”，而是相关报告到底是用来防灾，还是用来为“加快口岸建设”开绿灯。 二次重要研究显示：吉隆口岸高危 据《中国地质灾害与防治学报》所载研究论文，2015年尼泊尔发生大地震后，2020年有中国地质学者发表研究指出，吉隆县境内调查到183处地质灾害，包

title: [K-LIT REVIEW] Minyoung Kang's 'Plant Lady' gets comfortable with 'cozy horror'
snippet: A lush plant shop tucked away in an unassuming residential neighborhood; a lone woman snipping and pruning, enveloped by leaves and shoots she cares for with motherly tenderness; a small cast of ordinary characters each bearing issues the resolution of which promised happy endings; and lastly, the must-have feature — some cats. "Plant Lady" by Minyoung Kang has all the essential ingredients of a typical cozy read. If you disregard the murders, that is. My advice for this book is to skip the blurb. Do not read it at all. This is coming from someone who sorely regrets scrutinizing the blurb from start to finish before diving into the book. Had I ignored the synopsis of events, the preposterous juxtaposition of a soothing neighborhood plant shop and the gruesome plot that unfolds in it would have been 10 times more impactful. Instead, this book is best approached from the following angles: feminine rage, cozy horror and a fast-paced plot that takes no prisoners. Start with feminine rage.

And in no way should it lead to a false feeling of “mission accomplished” that lets the guard down. Leftists such as Ocasio-Cortez may be laughing off what they call the excesses of “Woke 1,” but they are already trotting out “Woke 2.” This is all calculated. It has a lot to do with electoral positioning, in no way amounts to a mea culpa, and lets guilty parties off the hook. snippet: Negative views of the United States prevail in many countries in Europe and Asia, including some of Washington’s longtime allies, while Israel remains a notable exception, according to a Pew Research Center survey. Across the 42,151 adults surveyed in 36 countries, a median of 37 percent had favorable views of the U.S., compared with 57 percent who viewed it unfavorably. Only seven countries had a majority with positive views of the U.S. during the time of the survey, which was conducted between Feb. 8 and May 13. Views were particularly negative in Europe. title: 八九学运领袖季风“被失踪” 或因一首诗？
snippet: 【大纪元2026年08月27日讯】（大纪元记者唐兵综合报导）八九学运贵州领袖、诗人季风日前从河北被强制押回贵州后，处于“失踪”状态。有人猜测，季风此次被抓的导火索或因其前不久所作的一首诗。 季风“被失踪” 据维权网8月25日消息，住在河北燕郊的八九学运领袖、贵州独立思想者、诗人季风，已被贵州遵义政保强制押回贵州了。目前季风音信全无，处于强迫失踪状态。 季风的朋友表示，季风是8月20日上午被带走的，他的行李都打了包拿走了，房东已把房子清空。当时来了很多人，特警也来了，动静挺大，周围不少邻居都看到了。据知是北京这边主导的，起因可能与他的网络言论有关。 消息还称，季风于3月份就被以寻衅滋事立案了。 或因一首诗 另据“民生观察”报导，有人猜测，季风此次被抓的导火索或因其前不久所作的一首诗，涉及今年8月去世的前中共总理朱镕基有关棺材的反腐言论。其全文如下： 最后一口棺材 文／季风 今天我看见一个时代 存放二十多年的一口棺材 终于盖上了最后一块板 那九十九口棺材里装满了贪官 仍然供不应求但没有人敢去抢 他预留的那最后一口 那棺材里躺着 一个时代的故事或事故 一直在网上发酵 没有人敢否认 他是个能臣 是好是坏 至今却无法盖棺 那些早年下岗后 成为爷爷奶奶的人 今天仍刷着手机 关心儿孙怎样活下去 只有他那一对 成功挣得盆满钵满的儿女 仍然坚信父亲是个清官 至死不渝 2026年8月18日于燕郊 季风出生于1960年代，贵州桐梓县娄山关镇人，是诗人、资深策划、企业私人顾问。他是贵州大学中文系86级学生，在1989年学运期间出任贵州大学“高自联”主席，并在之后因此入狱两年多，此后一直被中共当局严密监控、打压，禁止出境。他曾暂住深圳、北京等地，长年遭到国保驱赶。 2023年六四前夕，季风被迫离开北京，当时向大纪元记者表示，北京国保驱赶他不让他住在北京，贵阳国保驱赶他不允许他待在贵阳，逼迫他回贵州桐梓县老家。他只好流浪到了湖南。 季风曾在Twitter（现改名为X）上称，自己是“当代国家囚徒，八九六四学运带头人，黑夜中的思想者，思考者，诗人，踯躅中孤独的夜行人。三十多年来生活在别处，这个国家的别处，左手写文案赚钱度日，右手写文章陶冶情操。在深圳暂住10年非深圳人，在北京暂住20多年仍不是北京人，长期被监控边控不能发声不能出境，被流放了大半个中国，搬了30多次家，至今仍食无定处，居无定所。”
source: 大纪元 Epoch Times · 即时

title: Romanian president refers Decarbonisation Law amendments breaching RRF to Constitutional Court
snippet: Romanian president Nicușor Dan has referred amendments to the Decarbonisation Law to the Constitutional Court, warning of risks to the environment and to the implementation of milestone 114 under the National Recovery and Resilience Plan (PNRR), according to a Presidency statement on August 26. The dispute could also affect EU funding linked to the reform. The amendments, adopted by Parliament on August 5 and mainly supported by the Social Democratic Party (PSD) and Alliance for the Union of Romanians (AUR), change provisions governing the closure of coal- and lignite-fired power plants. The revised rules link the closure of some capacities to the availability of alternative low-carbon energy sources, potentially altering the timetable initially agreed under the PNRR. snippet: With the cost of living on every voter’s mind, an old idea is getting a new push on Capitol Hill: fixing a flaw in the tax code that makes everything more expensive. But that gain is measured against the price you paid, not your true cost. title: Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh demand safe return to Myanmar
snippet: COX'S BAZAR, Bangladesh — Tens of thousands of Rohingya refugees from Myanmar living in dozens of camps in Bangladesh held a rally Tuesday to demand their safe return to their home state, nine years after they fled a government crackdown. The demonstrators urged the international community to ensure security in Rakhine state as they marked what they call the “Ninth Anniversary of Rohingya Genocide Day.” More than 1 million refugees from Myanmar’s Rohingya ethnic and religious minority now live in the sprawling camps around the Cox’s Bazar district of southeastern Bangladesh. Most of them fled across the border in a mass exodus in 2017 after Buddhist-majority Myanmar launched a crackdown in Rakhine, following an attack by a Rohingya Muslim insurgent group. The Bangladesh government earlier attempted to start the repatriation at least twice, but it did not work out as none of the refugees was willing to go back, citing security concerns. Bangladesh says it will not force anyone to return

title: Population mobility falls in July amid housing market slowdown
snippet: The number of Koreans who moved to new residences decreased in July from a year earlier amid a decline in housing transactions, data showed Wednesday. Around 468,000 people changed residences in July, down 86,000 from the same one-month period in 2025, according to data from the Ministry of Data and Statistics. It was the lowest figure since 460,000 posted in July 2022. The population mobility rate — the number of people relocating per 100 residents — fell 2 percentage points from a year earlier to 10.8 percent. The data ministry said the decline apparently came as the number of homes traded in May and June, which is reflected in the July data, fell 0.9 percent on-year. "There may also have been a base effect, as housing-related indicators were strong in July last year," a statistics official said. title: Births up 15.6% in June, extend gains for 24th month
snippet: The number of babies born in Korea rose 15.6 percent in June from a year earlier, marking the 24th consecutive month of on-year growth, government data showed Wednesday. A total of 23,111 babies were born in June, up 3,115 from 19,996 a year earlier, according to the Ministry of Data and Statistics. The growth rate was the highest since the government began compiling relevant data in 1981. The increase in absolute terms was also the largest since 1992, when the figure rose by 3,666. The country's total fertility rate, the average number of children a woman is expected to have in her lifetime, rose 0.11 point from a year earlier to 0.88 in June. The fertility rate remains well below the 2.1 births per woman needed to maintain a stable population without immigration. The number of births has maintained an upward trend since July 2024. title: Bangladesh could join Mecca pact, official suggests
snippet: Bangladesh could join Mecca pact, official suggests Bangladesh may be joining the defence agreement signed by Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan earlier this month. Bangladeshi State Minister for Foreign Affairs Humayun Kabir told reporters on Monday that his country has been invited to participate in what has become known as the Mecca pact, but did not say who extended the invitation. Reuters news agency, however, cited an unnamed source saying Riyadh had reached out to Dhaka. "If there is a security arrangement among Islamic nations in the Middle East, it is not unusual for us to consider participating. It is being viewed positively," Kabir said. The agreement stipulates that an armed attack against any of the three countries shall be regarded as an attack against all three, in a formula approaching the collective defence logic of major military alliances like Nato. title: 叙利亚库尔德武装宣布解散 编入政府军
snippet: 【大纪元2026年08月26日讯】（大纪元记者王君宜综合报导）周二（8月25日），叙利亚库尔德族主导的“叙利亚民主力量”（SDF）宣布解散，其部队已完成编入叙利亚国家军队。这是叙利亚政府与SDF今年1月达成的武装整合协议取得的重要进展。 当天，SDF指挥官马兹鲁姆·阿卜迪（Mazloum Abdi）在大马士革人民宫发表电视讲话，宣布“叙利亚民主力量”任务结束，不再作为独立军事力量存在。 阿卜迪表示，在与叙利亚总统艾哈迈德·沙拉（Ahmed al-Sharaa）达成协议并完成部队整合后，SDF的使命已经结束。叙利亚国家通讯社SANA也证实，SDF已完成编入叙利亚军队各旅。 SDF是一支多族群武装力量，由库尔德武装主导，包括阿拉伯等族群在内。自2015年成立以来，SDF在美国支持下参与打击“伊斯兰国”，并曾控制叙利亚北部和东部大片地区。 今年1月，叙利亚政府与SDF达成协议，决定分阶段将SDF的军事力量和民政机构纳入国家体系。美国当时称这项协议是“历史性里程碑”。 在协议达成前，叙利亚政府军今年1月与SDF发生武装冲突。政府军随后控制SDF此前掌握的大部分地区，双方之后达成停火，并加快推进武装力量整合。 作为SDF核心力量的库尔德人民保护部队（YPG）也已开始参与整合。其指挥官西潘·哈莫（Sipan Hamo）今年3月被任命为叙利亚副国防部长，负责东部地区事务。 大马士革加快国家重建 SDF解散之际，叙利亚新政府正加快整合国内各方武装力量，推动国家机构恢复运行。叙利亚自2011年爆发内战以来，长期陷入武装冲突，在前总统巴沙尔·阿萨德（Bashar al-Assad）执政期间也长期面临国际孤立。 目前，沙拉领导的叙利亚过渡政府正推动政治过渡、整合武装力量和国家重建，并积极改善与美国等西方国家的关系。美国8月24日正式撤销对叙利亚的“支持恐怖主义国家”认定，进一步改善华盛顿与大马士革的关系，为叙利亚经济复苏和吸引外部投资创造条件。 （本文参考了路透社的报导） 责任编辑：李沐恩#

title: The Psychology of Tribalism Is Damaging Politics
snippet: Since he first walked this earth, man has organized himself into tribes. There is safety in numbers and, along with physical and practical advantages, comes the most appealing benefit: belonging. Politics is no different. With the midterm election looming, examining the psychological forces and incentives that drive tribal behavior can help us understand political movements and electoral outcomes. For most of the human species, the feeling of belonging isn’t just a desire; it is a biological and psychological necessity. We are, after all, social creatures. Broadly speaking, voters and activists are initially drawn to political tribes (and politicians) by one of four psychological motivations—the Four Ps: principle, practicality, personality, or popularity. Members can join the same tribe but for different reasons. Principle is rooted in a set of unchanging beliefs or convictions. title: What the Odd July Jobs Report Means for the Fed
snippet: Last month, jobs in the American economy fell by 23,000, yet the unemployment rate improved to 4.1%, giving ammunition to conflicting narratives. The economic pessimists point to falling jobs, and the optimists point to an unemployment rate that matches or beats seven in eight months over the past 50 years. So, are we in a jobs recession, or is everything fine? Paradoxically enough, both the jobs and unemployment rates come from the notorious Bureau of Labor Statistics, but they have different sources. Payroll growth is estimated through a survey of employers—which has pathetically low response rates, so it’s mostly guesstimates until later tested against more accurate data. Meanwhile, unemployment rates come from a separate survey of households. The first counts jobs, the second counts people. title: «Más altos, más rápidos, más fuertes»: robots que pulverizan récords humanos
snippet: Los Juegos se remontan a la Antigua Grecia , pero quizá llegue el día en que una variante alternativa, sin humanos, se atribuya a la China contemporánea. Este escenario futurista es ya una realidad en Pekín, que estos días acoge la segunda edición de los Juegos Mundiales de Robots Humanoides, celebrada, para afilar el simbolismo, en el antiguo recinto olímpico. Aquí, androides participan en todo tipo de competiciones en una exhibición del poderío tecnológico de la potencia emergente. Miedo. En uno de los pasillos interiores del estadio aparece un robot ataviado con casco y guantes, protecciones que no necesita, dispuesto a repartir mamporros en una pelea de kick-boxing. Cada vez que alguien le corta el paso se detiene, solo porque está programado para ello. ¿Llegará el día en que seamos nosotros –pocas veces hubo un nosotros tan amplio– los que nos detengamos ante ellos? El sonido de sus articulaciones metálicas, sus pasos decididos –esto es, carentes de decisión– producen, sí, miedo.

snippet: The Romanian Air Force will open the flight program at the Bucharest International Air Show (BIAS) 2026 on Saturday, August 29. The aerial program will include aerobatics, tactical demonstrations, and formation flights featuring F-16 Fighting Falcon jets, C-27J Spartan and C-130 Hercules transport aircraft, and IAR-330 helicopters, according to the Ministry of Defense. Military aircraft from Spain, Germany, France, Italy, Turkey, and Slovenia will also perform at this year’s event at the invitation of the Romanian Air Force. The static exhibition will feature an F-16 Fighting Falcon, a C-27J Spartan, IAR-330 and IAR-316B Alouette helicopters, and an IAK-52 training aircraft. Visitors will also be able to see a replica of the Vlaicu II aircraft, a full-scale model of the IAR-80, an IAR-317 Airfox helicopter, and a TPS-79R radar. title: 美技工需求激增 4大企业联合扩大在30州培训
snippet: 【大纪元2026年08月22日讯】（大纪元记者李梅综合报导）总部位于纽约的全球最大跨国资产管理公司贝莱德（BlackRock），透过1亿美元的贝莱德基金会慈善倡议，于6月1日发起首个全国性提案征集（RFP），旨在支持美国熟练技工与技术人才的培训与发展、支撑经济增长。 截至周四（20日），名为“贝莱德未来建设者”（BlackRock Future Builders）的该项目收到了上千份申请，累计寻求的资助金额超过9亿美元，凸显了市场对熟练技工的需求及个人职业拓展的机遇。 强大需求 在6月1日至7月10日为期6周的申请期内，来自50个州和华盛顿特区的申请包括了暖通空调（HVAC）技师、电工、管道工、焊工、管道装配工、钢铁工人等多种职业，公司将于10月公布资助名单。 项目执行负责人凯利（John Kelly）表示，来自各州的反馈揭示了一个严峻挑战：“对熟练技工人才的需求已超过现有培训体系的培养能力。” 公司认为，美国面临建设下一代关键基础设施的空前机遇，实现老旧基础设施的现代化改造预计投入2万亿资金。而要把握机遇，就需要一支具备相应技能的劳动力队伍，来负责设计、建造、运营和维护基础设施。据估计，到2030年，将面临210万个技术工种岗位的空缺。 创建联盟 四家不同领域的美国领先企业——贝莱德、卡哈特（Carhartt）、福特汽车公司（Ford）和谷歌（Google）上月联合宣布，将建立“美国技工联盟”（Alliance for America’s Skilled Trades），以扩大技术工人培训的覆盖范围、满足不断增长的需求。 技工职业可能包括建筑类工种（木工、管道工、电工）、暖通空调与能源技术人员、焊接与制造加工、先进制造、汽车与电动汽车（EV）技术人员、数据中心与基础设施相关交易等。 联盟旨在以下三个关键领域扩大影响力： 1. 构建技术工人人才储备库，让更多美国人有机会接触并了解技术行业。提高公众意识，提供清晰便捷的行业准入途径，让更多人转型到更稳定、工资更高、能长期发展并为社区带来经济效益的领域。 2. 投资学徒制和预备学徒制项目，创造边工作边学习的机会，无需大学学位即可获得高薪职业，推广以实证为基础的劳动力发展模式。这些项目能够帮助更多美国工人获得关键的新技能和经济流动性。 3. 拓展合作伙伴关系，与志同道合的行业、劳工、教育和非营利组织合作，惠及全国更多的工人
source: 大纪元 Epoch Times · 即时

title: 美婚姻绿卡申请 律师析拒批原因 提补救建议
snippet: 【大纪元2026年08月22日讯】（大纪元记者马尚恩洛杉矶报导）长期以来，婚姻移民是在美获得身份成功率最高的途径之一，但近年大量出现的虚假婚姻，使之蒙上了阴影，让拥有真实婚姻的移民在办理身份时也遇到重重难关。洛杉矶移民律师梁少华近日受访时，总结了申请婚姻绿卡失败的多种原因以及补救措施。 婚姻真实性审查日趋严格 据梁少华观察，总体上看，从2026年起，婚姻绿卡豁免面谈基本已成历史，“几乎所有案子都要现场面谈，对身份转换的敏感案件，包括庇护转绿卡、B1/B2短期入境后结婚、逾期滞留后结婚，审查尤其详细”。 除面谈外，今年以来，移民局对婚姻移民申请的欺诈调查与突击查访更为频繁，对申请者的社交媒体审查也有强化趋势。 过去，通过婚姻作境内身份调整常常被视为默认途径，但现在这已成为“例外恩惠”。既然是“恩惠”，官员开始更注重考察申请人在美国整体身份维持的历史以及个人品行。 在真实性审查方面，以往，如果申请者提供了联名账户、租房合同、合影等证明材料，通常就可以过关，现已不足以说服移民官员。申请者往往需要补充更长时间、更有说服力、能证明婚姻实际存在的共同生活证据。 婚姻移民申请失败的原因 随着审查趋严，婚姻绿卡申请失败的案例越来越多。梁少华将失败原因归纳如下： 1. 婚姻真实性证据不足，比如，申请者提供的婚姻双方财务交织较浅，地址不一致，面谈时双方的回答有不一致之处等。官员如果在突击查访时，发现夫妻实际上分居，也会增加失败风险。 2. 经济担保（I-864）不达标。美国公民或绿卡持有人在为外籍配偶申请婚姻绿卡时，需要提供I-864经济担保书（Affidavit of Support），以确保外籍配偶不会成为政府负担，在美期间不会依赖公共福利。根据移民局提供的联邦贫困线指南（I-864P），担保人的收入必须达到贫困线的125%；收入越高，在此一点上越有利于申请者。 3.存在不可入境的事项。如果被申请者有过重罪、非法入境无豁免、未撤销的递解令、婚姻欺诈等记录，不利于成功申请。 4.社交媒体信息与申报信息有矛盾。去年，川普政府开始扩大对签证及移民申请人的社交媒体审查。申请者需要披露过去五年的社交媒体账户，重点涉及反美言论或威胁国家安全的言论。 梁律师认为，现在移民官员在面谈之前，会调查双方的社交媒体账号，并对比互动频率、合影时间线与申报婚姻的时间线；如发现异常，可能会做进一步了解或安排二

title: Tanker traffic at Saudi Arabia's Yanbu port falls by a third, report says
snippet: Tanker traffic at Saudi Arabia's Yanbu port falls by a third, report says Tanker traffic at Yanbu, Saudi Arabia's main Red Sea oil terminal, has fallen by more than a third since Yemen’s Houthis announced a blockade of Saudi vessels through the Bab al-Mandeb strait on July 20, Lloyd's List Intelligence reports. To deal with the blockade, Saudi energy giant Aramco relies on a three-part operation to ship crude: shuttle tankers carry crude from Yanbu to Egypt’s Ain Sukhna, the SUMED pipeline pipes it across to Egypt’s Mediterranean port of Sidi Kerir, and vessels reload there for onward delivery, according to the report. While the route keeps Saudi crude flowing, it requires more tankers and adds weeks to voyages for Asian buyers.

title: Lee's approval rating inches up from record low to 45%: poll
snippet: President Lee Jae Myung's approval rating rose slightly this week after hitting a record low, a poll showed Friday. In a survey conducted by Gallup Korea from Tuesday through Thursday on 1,004 people aged 18 and older, 45 percent positively assessed Lee's management of state affairs, up 1 percentage point from a record low of 44 percent in the previous survey released last week. Lee's disapproval rating also stood at 45 percent, while 11 percent said they were undecided. title: 弗里蒙特印度独立日大游行 多族裔共庆传统文化与美国自由
snippet: 【大纪元2026年08月21日讯】（大纪元记者楚州弗里蒙特市报导）美国加州湾区弗里蒙特（Fremont）市8月16日举行印度独立日大型游行及文化庆典，来自该市和附近县市的多个族裔的民众、文化团体和民选官员齐聚街头，共庆佳节。 弗里蒙特市长：让不同族裔在同一个城市彼此了解 弗里蒙特市长Raj Salwan在接受大纪元采访时表示，这是一个“令人兴奋的日子”。他说，刚庆祝美国独立250周年，如今又迎来印度第80个独立纪念日，对当地社区来说是个重要时刻。 他说：“我们希望通过庆祝活动社区所有成员——不同族裔、不同背景的人——聚集在一起，创造一个对所有人都积极、友善的环境。” 谈到印度文化对美国社会的影响，Salwan表示，印度文化与中华文化一样，都拥有非常悠久的历史，其中包含丰富的家庭传统、价值观以及对他人的关怀。 他特别提到印度文化中的精神性以及“人类彼此相连”的概念，认为这些传统能够为美国社会带来正面影响。 “我们很自豪，弗里蒙特是一座欢迎多元文化的城市。”他说。 Salwan于2024年12月宣誓就任市长，是该市首位印度裔美国市长。 加州州长候选人Steve Hilton：印度裔对加州成功贡献巨大 参加活动的还有本届加州州长候选人Steve Hilton。 Hilton在接受大纪元采访时表示，他本人长期与印度及印度裔朋友保持密切联系。 “我非常喜欢印度。”他说，并回忆自己在英国成长的经历。他表示，英国与印度有着复杂而悠久的历史关系，而自己一生中都有来自印度的朋友。 来到加州后，他同样结识了许多印度裔朋友，因此很自豪能够在湾区参加印度独立日庆典。 谈到加州的文化多元性，Hilton说：“这就是加州的全部意义。” 他特别强调印度裔美国人对加州经济和社会发展的贡献，尤其是在硅谷科技产业以及商业领域。 他说，“印度人民为加州的成功作出了非常巨大的贡献。” 民选官员：印度文化已成为湾区社会的重要组成部分 弗里蒙特市议员邵阳在接受大纪元采访时表示，印度独立日庆典不仅是印度裔社区庆祝自己的传统，也是不同族裔共同建立社区的机会。 他说，许多来自弗里蒙特以及其它城市的民选官员来到现场，显示这项活动已成为湾区多元文化交流的重要平台。 邵阳还表示，华人社区同样能够理解这种文化认同。他说，华人庆祝中国新年，也庆祝美国国庆；同样，印度裔美国人庆祝印度独立日时，其它族裔也可以参与其中。 他强调：

title: Kakao to split into two listed firms
snippet: Kakao said Friday it will split into two listed companies, Kakao AI and Kakao X, as the IT giant restructures its businesses around artificial intelligence. Kakao AI will house KakaoTalk, South Korea’s dominant mobile messenger, along with the company’s AI, advertising and commerce businesses. Kakao X will bring together fintech, content and mobility under an investment-focused structure. On Friday, the company’s board approved the demerger under which Kakao AI will be spun off as a new company

title: US vows to 'collapse' Iran with new sanctions as energy prices spike
snippet: US vows to 'collapse' Iran with new sanctions as energy prices spike The US will impose "the toughest sanctions in history” on Iran, Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent said on Thursday, vowing to ramp up economic pressure on the Islamic Republic even as the economic toll of the war builds. "It is a one-two punch. We have the blockade [on Iran], and we are going to have the toughest sanctions in history," Bessent told CNBC. "It is going to work in Iran, and we are going to collapse this regime,” he said, adding that the sanctions will be explained on Monday. Bessent’s statements come a day after Trump said that he was launching an "economic D-Day" on Iran, and warned that any country helping Tehran would face "TREMENDOUS Economic Consequences". Other states should treat the president’s order as the floor for vaccine freedom, not the ceiling. title: SK hynix labor, management reach tentative agreement for 2026 wages
snippet: Labor and management of SK hynix have reached a tentative agreement on 2026 wages, under which 60 percent of performance bonuses will be paid in treasury shares, according to industry officials Thursday. SK hynix’s labor and management drew significant attention across the Korean industry last year when they agreed to use 10 percent of the company’s operating profit as a funding pool for performance bonuses and maintain the system for 10 years. Tensions escalated recently, however, after management proposed paying part of the bonuses in shares instead of entirely in cash, prompting the unions to threaten collective action. title: EC requires Romania to thoroughly explain financing of new Wage Law for budgetary sector
snippet: On August 19, the European Commission sent a point of view to the Romanian government regarding the draft Wage Law for the budgetary sector, requesting clarifications on the budgetary sources for the RON 12 billion or higher increase in the payroll next year, as announced by interim prime minister Ilie Bolojan. snippet: 【大纪元2026年08月20日讯】（大纪元记者孙络采访报导）广东深圳一位房东近日在社交平台披露，其租客家中有朋友来访，因未向有关部门登记，房东被公安罚款500元。事件在网络传播后，不少深圳居民表示，当地出租屋人员登记检查严格，有人进入出租屋居住需要登记，人员离开后还要办理注销。 在大陆社交媒体聊天群，有深圳房东上传8月11日发出的“罚款通知书”。通知书显示，执罚单位为深圳市公安局龙岗分局下属派出所，执收项目为“公安罚没收入”，罚款金额500元，处罚原因写有“违反《治安管理处罚法》第六十八条第一款之规定”。房东说，租客的朋友当天刚到就被查到了。 出租屋管理收紧 居民深夜回家也要登记 在龙岗开餐厅的阿虎向记者披露，出租屋查人的次数越来越多，社区网格员和派出所都在登记外来人员。有的社区，居民晚上超过12点回家也要登记。他说：“以前大家觉得租个房子就是自己的生活空间，现在越来越严，朋友过来住一下也要考虑会不会有人来查。” 阿虎表示，他的一个朋友要去他家，也要通知房东，再把信息报上去。他认为，这种管理很可能是要“出大事”。 根据中共今年1月1日起施行的新修订《治安管理处罚法》有关规定，房屋出租人将房屋出租给身份不明、拒绝登记身份信息的人，或者不按规定登记承租人姓名、有效身份证件种类和号码等信息，可处500元以上1000元以下罚款；情节较轻的，处警告或者500元以下罚款。 不过，上述条款直接使用的是“承租人”，并没有写“访客”或“来访人员”。深圳现行出租屋管理规定则要求出租人申报出租屋居住人员的姓名、联系方式、身份证件等资料；承租人不得留宿身份不明人员。朋友临时到访是否属于必须登记的“居住人员”，成为此次处罚争议的一个焦点。 维稳深入社区 维权人士批防民如防贼 广东维权人士黄先生认为，中共不断扩大基层人口管控，与当局长期强调的所谓“维稳”有关。他表示：“不公平的事情太多了，区政府、街道办不断出台扰民法规，限制公民自由，到处是保安、监控设备，动不动要你登记身份证，防民如防贼。最近很多农民工被解雇，他们怕农民工滞留，所以想办法驱赶，不让他们住在朋友家。” 深圳长期实行出租屋人口登记制度。相关规定还要求，人口和房屋综合管理机构加强出租屋和人口管理信息化建设，与公安机关居住登记申报系统共享信息，工作人员可以对申报信息进行实地核查。对于以小时、天数为单位出租房屋的出租人，还要求安装信息采

title: Unionized workers at No. 1 internet-only Kakao Bank to stage 5-day strike
snippet: Unionized workers at internet-only Kakao Bank will launch a five-day strike as talks with management over wage increases and other benefits have stalled, its union said Thursday. The labor union and Kakao Bank's management have been in negotiations over a pay raise and other benefits but failed to narrow outstanding differences. The union said the strike will run from Aug. 31 to Sept. 4. On July 31, the unionized workers also went on a full strike. In the first quarter of the year, Kakao Bank logged an operating income of 211 billion won ($143 million) on revenue of 1.94 trillion won, both quarterly highs. Unionized workers at the bank's parent, Kakao Corp., and its management, meanwhile, reached a final wage deal earlier this month after a three-month dispute.

title: KRX activates buy-side sidecar for KOSPI on sharp rise
snippet: Korea's bourse operator on Thursday activated a buy-side sidecar for the benchmark Korea Composite Stock Price Index (KOSPI) as the stock index sharply rose. Program trading for the KOSPI-listed shares was suspended for five minutes at 9:58 a.m., according to the Korea Exchange (KRX). After opening over 3 percent higher, the KOSPI gained 325.34 points, or 5.03 percent, to 6,790.39 as of 9:59 a.m. The index rebounded after plunging nearly 6 percent the previous session, tracking overnight gains on Wall Street as U.S. Treasury yields eased following plans for increased government debt buybacks. A buy-side sidecar is triggered when the KOSPI 200 Futures Index rises 5 percent or more for at least one minute.

title: Students in Czech Republic Face Higher Rents as Housing Costs Rise
snippet: Students looking for private accommodation in Czech university cities this year are facing higher rents, with prices for some types of housing up by as much as 14 percent compared with 2025. The increase comes as demand for student accommodation reaches its annual peak ahead of the winter semester. Data from several Czech property platforms show that the busiest period started earlier this year, meaning students who have not yet found accommodation may face a more limited and expensive selection in September. Those unable to secure a place in a student dormitory generally have three alternatives: renting a small apartment alone, taking a private room in a shared apartment, or renting a bed in shared accommodation. The most expensive option is usually a small one-bedroom apartment with a kitchenette, typically around 30 square meters. snippet: Our renewable energy market is in a new stage. The number of MW announced, the pace of new developments and the volume of capital entering the market alone no longer tell the full story. title: Romania had highest inflation in EU in July 2026 despite decrease
snippet: Romania still has the highest inflation in the European Union, at 8.2% in July, even though the rate fell from 9.2% in the previous month, according to data published by Eurostat on Wednesday, August 19. Overall, inflation rose slightly to 3% at the EU level in July, from 2.9% in June. Compared with June, annual inflation fell in 15 member states, remained stable in three and increased in nine. After Romania, the next highest inflation was recorded in Lithuania, at 5.4%, and in Cyprus and Bulgaria, both at 4.4%. At the opposite end, Sweden had the lowest annual inflation, at 0.3%, followed by Czechia, at 1.3%, and Denmark and Hungary, at 1.6% each. In the euro area, the rate rose from 2.8% to 2.9% in July. The largest contribution to inflation in the euro area came from services, with 1.55%, followed by energy, with 0.94%, and food, alcohol and tobacco, with 0.23%. title: 58 Years Since Warsaw Pact Troops Invaded Czechoslovakia
snippet: On August 21, 1968, Soviet troops and their Warsaw Pact allies invaded Czechoslovakia to bring an end to that country’s brief period of political liberalization, called the Prague Spring. People still recall waking up on that fateful morning to find that Soviet-led Warsaw Pact tanks had rolled into the country, crushing all hope of implementing the democratic reforms of the Prague Spring. Shocked citizens took to the streets in protest of the invasion. About 500,000 troops were involved in the invasion and occupation, during which 137 Czechoslovaks died and some 500 were wounded. One of the key battles was for the control of Czech Radio, similar to the one that took place at the end of the Second World War. The invasion ended the political and economic reforms led by Alexander Dubcek and reasserted dominant Soviet and Communist authority in Czechoslovakia. snippet: Hyundai Motor Co. is expected to suffer cumulative production losses of more than 60,000 vehicles as its labor union steps up strike action amid stalled wage negotiations, industry sources said Wednesday. The continued strikes are expected to bring cumulative production losses from last month through Aug. 25 to around 62,000 vehicles, with lost sales estimated at 2.6 trillion won ($1.85 billion), according to industry sources familiar with the matter. title: Young Koreans' 1st-home buying hits 5-year high as Seoul rents soar
snippet: First-time home purchases by people in their 20s and 30s hit a nearly five-year high in Seoul in July, as rising “jeonse” rental costs and relatively accessible mortgage financing encouraged more young renters to enter the housing market, government data showed Wednesday. According to the Supreme Court’s real estate registration data, 7,547 first-home purchases were recorded in the capital city last month, the highest monthly figure since November 2021. Buyers in their 20s accounted for 887 transactions, or 11.8 percent of the total, while those in their 30s accounted for 4,300, or 57 percent. The surge comes as jeonse costs continue to rise. Under the uniquely Korean rental system, tenants pay a large lump-sum deposit instead of monthly rent. The apartment jeonse price index in Seoul rose to 104.39 in June from 100 at the start of the year, according to the Korea Real Estate Board. title: SAI Globinvest launches ETF replicating Bucharest Stock Exchange’s reference BET-XT index
snippet: Romanian investment management company SAI Globinvest listed its second ETF on the Regulated Market of the Bucharest Stock Exchange on Tuesday, August 18. The ETF, listed under the ticker symbol GIBXTETF, aims to fully replicate the structure of BVB's reference index (BET-XT). Launched by BVB in 2008, BET-XT is a price index that tracks the performance of the 30 most traded Romanian companies on the BVB Regulated Market. Having a broader composition than the benchmark BET index, it offers a wider perspective on the evolution of the Romanian capital market. The BET-XT index components include representative companies from key sectors of the Romanian economy, such as financial, energy, pharmaceutical, industrial, and utilities. The total market capitalization of all Romanian companies included in the BET-XT index stands at approximately RON 438 billion, representing 60% of the main segment's total market capitalization, which exceeded RON 724 billion at the end of the day on August 17. title: Famous hacker caught with false plates in Romania’s mountain resort of Sinaia
snippet: A famous Romanian hacker nicknamed Virus was caught in traffic in Sinaia, Prahova County, over the weekend despite the fact that his car was equipped with an ingenious system for changing license plates. The 42-year-old man was pulled over following an alert generated by the automatic license plate recognition system installed on a police vehicle. title: Rights group stages sit-in at Seoul subway station to demand improved access for disabled people
snippet: A disability rights activist group resumed a subway boarding protest in Seoul on Tuesday, causing trains to pass Seoul Station without stopping for about an hour. From 8:49 a.m. to 10:12 a.m., northbound trains on Line 4 and southbound trains on Lines 1 and 4 skipped Seoul Station, due to the protest by activists from the Solidarity Against Disability Discrimination. While attempting to board a southbound train on Line 4, the activists clashed with officials from Seoul Metro, the train operator, ultimately failing to take the train. The protesters said they will stage subway protests every morning starting Tuesday to demand adequate government budget allocations for disability rights. The group said it will also gather every morning at the Korea Fiscal Information Service in Seoul and crawl in a march toward the private residence of Health Minister Jeong Eun-kyeong as another form of appeal.

title: Container shipping costs to Middle East continue rising in July amid conflict
snippet: Container shipping costs from Korea to the Middle East continued rising in July, the customs agency said Tuesday, amid protracted geopolitical tensions in the region. The average shipping charge for a 40-foot container from Korea to the Middle East rose 14.5 percent from a month earlier to 8.78 million won ($6,217) in June, according to data from the Korea Customs Service. The reading has been rising since March. The average shipping charge for containers bound for the U.S. west coast rose 11.1 percent from a month earlier to 8.56 million won, while that for the east coast increased 14.4 percent to 8.14 million won. Shipping costs to the European Union jumped 36.4 percent to 5.68 million won. The figures include freight rates, commissions and other charges reported by local exporters, according to the agency.

title: Seoul shares open higher on tech gains amid Middle East concerns
snippet: Seoul shares opened higher Tuesday, led by gains by major chipmakers, despite overnight losses on Wall Street, as hopes for a deal to end the war with Iran fade. After opening 2 percent up, the benchmark Korea Composite Stock Price Index (KOSPI) extended gains, trading 166.91 points, or 2.39 percent, higher at 7,144.85 as of 9:15 a.m. Overnight, the Dow Jones Industrial Average shed 0.51 percent, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq composite declined 0.32 percent. title: Czech Fish Farmers Take Emergency Measures Amid Prolonged Drought
snippet: Fish farmers reduce or suspend supplementary feeding to lower oxygen consumption, reports say. Fish farmers in the Czech Republic have begun taking emergency measures as a prolonged drought, worsened by high temperatures across Europe, strains water supplies. Facing water shortages, fish farmers have reduced or suspended supplementary feeding to lower fish oxygen consumption, while ponds are being regularly aerated, according to the report. Several ponds have also been netted earlier than usual. In the Třeboň area, which delivers tons of carp for the Czech Christmas table, part of the 200-hectare Koclířov pond has been drained and the fish moved to holding tanks. More than a third of the water is missing from the region’s famous system of fish ponds due to the drought. The water level in Lake Svět, for example, has fallen by 98 centimetres. title: Romania’s GDP virtually flat for third consecutive quarter
snippet: Romania’s seasonally adjusted GDP remained constant in the second quarter of 2026, compared to Q1, and was 2% y/y lower than in the same period of 2025, according to flash estimate data published by the statistics office INS. After the marginal 0.1% q/q contraction in Q1, Romania’s economic activity remained for the third consecutive quarter roughly at the same level – which is the same level as that of Q2 2024. The country’s GDP in the whole first half of the year (H1) contracted by 1.6% y/y. Under the national methodology (that uses the previous year period’s prices for GDP aggregation, as opposed to the whole year’s average prices used by Eurostat), Romania’s GDP decreased by only 0.4% y/y in Q2, after the 1.2% y/y decline in Q1 – resulting in a milder 0.8% y/y annual economic contraction for the whole H1 period. title: Coreia do Sul planeja data center submarino para atender demanda por inteligência artificial
snippet: A Coreia do Sul está desenvolvendo planos para um data center submarino, em busca de espaço para acomodar a crescente infraestrutura de inteligência artificial (IA) em um país com território limitado. Em abril, o Ministério dos Oceanos e Pescas escolheu Ulsan, no sudeste do país e importante polo das indústrias automobilística e naval, para um projeto de demonstração que poderá abrir caminho para um complexo de infraestrutura de IA no fundo do mar. Servidores e outros equipamentos serão instalados em grandes unidades semelhantes a contêineres de transporte, que ficarão submersas a 20 metros de profundidade. As unidades poderão ser adicionadas de forma modular, permitindo ampliar a instalação para até 100 mil servidores. O projeto-piloto terá custo estimado de 51,1 bilhões de won (US$ 35,4 milhões). Os testes devem começar ainda neste ano, enquanto a construção da instalação comercial está prevista para 2031. As unidades terão de suportar uma pressão três vezes maior que a atmosférica.

title: Italy’s mythic ‘month off’ in August was hard won. It would be good for us all | Jamie Mackay

These are the stubborn devotees of villeggiatura : Italy’s mythic, month-long summer break.
